name: Saudi Tadawul Group Holding Company (Tadawul Group)
method: Text layer (PyMuPDF) plus page rendering. New tool stmt_pages.py: a statement counts as text-confirmed only if a page has the statement title near the top AND >=12 numeric tokens; image-only pages listed. Arithmetic cross-foots (A=L+E, CF end cash = BS cash, Q1+Q2 = 6M).

dimension_1_value_correctness.summary: Extractable and verified from rendered pages: FY2025 (with FY2024 comparatives), Q1 2026, H1 2026, FY2024 balance sheet (original issue). Not read: the other issuer statement sets (structure/presence only), annual reports, Arabic twins. Units: Saudi Riyals, full units; consolidated; per-share SAR.

transcriptions.checks: FY2024 balance sheet equals the comparatives in the FY2025 report (no 2024 restatement); Dec-2023 column labelled Restated

dimension_1_value_correctness.sign_and_scale_notes: Statements are in full SAR; investor bulletins are in SAR thousands and use scrambled row/column order in the Cash Flows snapshot, so bulletins must not be used as a value source. Balance sheet grosses up clearing-participant financial assets/liabilities (about SAR 3.8bn each side): total assets are not comparable to a normal operating company.
dimension_1_value_correctness.bulletin_vs_statement_check: FY2024 bulletin snapshot: total assets 9,141,225.3k, revenue 1,446,558.8k, EPS 5.18 agree with the audited statements.

dimension_2_document_completeness.summary: Roughly 44 files are full issuer statement sets (English and Arabic twins per period), ~16 are summary bulletins that the inventory counted as financial_statements (7pp) or statements (12pp), 4 are annual reports, ~7 earnings/press releases (2 of them unrelated news).

defects.what: In essentially every issuer/Saudi-Exchange FS PDF the primary statements are image-only pages with NO text layer (e.g. interim: PDF p3-p7/8; FY2025: p19-23; FY2024: p7-11), while notes and the auditor report have text. The inventory statement_pages entries for these files point at TOC, notes or bulletin summary pages, so the files_with_all_three_primary_statements / text_extractable counts overstate machine-readability: text extraction yields zero statement rows for them. Rendering confirmed the statements exist (Q1 2022 twin scans, Q2 2023, FY2024, FY2025, Q1 2026, H1 2026).

7-page Investor Bulletins (FY23, FY24, Q1/Q3 24, H1 24, Q1/H1/Q3 25, Q1-Q3 23) and the 12-page Q1/H1 2026 bulletins are not statements; the 12-page ones say "& Financial Statements" in the title but contain none (rendered). Bulletin tables are SAR thousands snapshots.

Saudi-Exchange-sourced FY files carry the publication year: 57e17fb2 (FY2022) as 2023|FY, 8dcecc8f (FY2023) as 2024|FY, bac70ea0 (FY2024) as 2024|FY and 2025|FY, 162f5418 (FY2025) as 2025|FY and 2026|FY. 9eef690e (Arabic FY2024) has no label.

FY2025: 162f5418 and 06965f63 are two issues (2026-03-02, 2026-03-12) with pixel-identical statements; 9M 2025: d386113d and fc0faf3a have identical text; Q1 2022: 8f9bf3d9 mis-classed non-statement although it is the English twin of scan 1124dfba.
ddb32fdd (labelled 2022|9M) and dea96424 (2022|H1) are Arabic corporate-news press releases, not results.

dimension_3_company_coverage.inventory_claim: coverage_class sparse; first observed period 2021|FY (listing Dec 2021)
dimension_3_company_coverage.corrected_from_pages: Every period Q1 2022 - H1 2026 (18 interim) and FY2022-FY2025 (4 annual) has at least one full statement set in raw (English; Arabic twin for most), but the statements are image pages needing OCR or visual reading. FY2021 (listing year) and anything earlier is absent; Q4 discrete periods must be derived (FY minus 9M). No 2026 FY expected. Only FY2025, FY2024 (BS), Q1 2026, H1 2026 were read for values; the rest are structure-confirmed (rendered: Q1 2022 x2, Q2 2023).
dimension_3_company_coverage.annual_reports: AR 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 present; AR 2025 has text-layer statements (PDF p101-107)
